summary: Rocket Companies, Inc. filed this Form 8-K to announce a private offering of $600M in senior notes due 2031 and $600M in senior notes due 2034. Proceeds will refinance existing debt, such as Rocket Mortgage's 2.875% notes due 2026. The notes are unsecured, guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries, and sold under Rule 144A/Regulation S. The filing also includes unaudited Mr. Cooper financials related to a prior acquisition. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation event, so it is classified as None.
